sentences.text: Hmph. Luna, I reviewed the sensor data, and there is no evidence of anything supernatural happening in the bathroom.
The humidity reading in the bathroom was observed at 50.5 %, which is significantly below the expected range of 53.6 % to 55.8 %.
This drop suggests that the air was being exchanged, meaning maybe a window was left open during the period from 03:20 to 06:00.
It was probably just normal ventilation causing the air to dry out, not any ghostly activity.
